title: Play Store Update Info
meta_description: Update your play store app to newest version and fix play store error and update
full_description: Update your Play Store As you are probably aware, the Play Store is a crucial programme for Android phones. Google developed it, but it does not offer a download version, so you cannot get it and install it on your own. Therefore, we created this app to make it easier for you to update your Play Store app to the most recent or original version.The Play Store Update feature1. Upgrade to the newest version of your Play Store app.Step 1: Go to the APPLICATION INFO page of the Google Play Store and select the menu in the top right corner.Step 2: To remove updates, click the "Uninstall updates" option.Step 3: On the pop-up window, click "Ok."Wait a moment, and you will see that the most recent Play Store will automatically download.Step 5: The most recent Play Store version will be automatically installed on your phone once the files have finished downloading. This process may take a while, so be patient.2. Restore the original version of your Play Store app.Step 1: Go to the APPLICATION INFO page of the Google Play Store and select the menu in the top right corner.Step 2: To remove updates, click the "Uninstall updates" option.Step 3 : Click "Ok" button on the popwindow.Step 4 : When uninstall updates complete.the Play Store app will back to original version.Quickly check the status of the Google Play services with this small utility app. The version number, installation date, and most recent update date are displayed. Additionally, links to the developer release notes, the Play Store, and the app info dialogue are provided.The Google Play services can be installed or updated via the app.Open the app details panel and choose "clear cache" to attempt and resolve "Google Play Services has stopped" issues. Attempt the "uninstall updates" option if that doesn't work. Utilizing the Play Store link, download and reinstall the most recent version of the Google Play services.You may also check the status of Google Play Store, Instant Apps, Google Services Framework, and Google Account Manager in the new "Details" page.Google Play Store is a good Android APP Store, more and more people select play store to download APPS,there are some settings on Play Store,but only a few people skills to use that's settings,so this app help you a shortcut for Play Store Settings.Update your play store app to newest version and fix play store error and update.Play Store Settings Shortcut help you Play Store info of Play Store Settings.Thank you to be used Play Store Settings Shortcut , if you discover any question please contact me to resolve.
